status: preregistered before any production simulation; changes must be versioned and justified
contact_definition: minimum heavy-atom distance <= cutoff (geometric; not a hydrogen bond or energy)

burn_in_ns.note: excluded from the start of production, after the 1.35 ns staged equilibration

statistical_unit: independent replicate (frames are correlated and are never treated as observations)

residue_correspondence.rule: match by chain and residue number; residue names differ only at the demethylated positions
residue_correspondence.protein: identical in both conditions (native Ala140 after preparation)

primary_pairs.selection_rule: every residue-nucleotide pair with minimum heavy-atom distance <= 4.5 A in the 3C2I crystal model that involves an mCpG nucleotide (B8, B9, C33, C34), plus Thr158-DT31 (the residue highlighted by Ho et al. 2008); selected from the crystal geometry, not from any simulation
primary_pairs.methyl_mediated_note: for pairs whose closest crystal atom is the methyl carbon C5A, part of any mCpG-CpG difference is created by the construction itself (the atom is deleted)

confirmatory_family.rationale: the two arginine-guanine contacts of the symmetric mCpG step (closest atoms NH2-O6 in the crystal); neither is methyl-mediated, so a difference cannot arise by construction
confirmatory_family.statistic: difference of replicate-mean occupancy (mCpG - CpG), primary cutoff and burn-in
confirmatory_family.test: two-sided exact permutation test over replicate labels (5 vs 5: 252 splits; smallest attainable p = 2/252 = 0.0079), Holm correction over the 2 pairs
confirmatory_family.effect_size_reporting: every replicate value, the difference of means, and a bootstrap interval over replicates (10,000 resamples)
confirmatory_family.pilot: no tests in the pilot (3 vs 3 permits no meaningful test); descriptive only

per_replicate: contact_occupancy (all pairs; primary pairs reported explicitly)
contact_episodes for primary pairs: number, observed durations (lower bounds), censoring
min_distances for primary pairs (max_distance 12 A; absent = > 12 A): median, 10th/90th percentiles
backbone_rmsd (alignment: backbone N CA C O of protein residues 91-162; reference: first production frame)
measurements.between_conditions: per primary pair: replicate values, mean per condition, difference of means
exploratory: contacts to the 5-methyl marker atom (mCpG only; no counterpart in CpG)
distances from Arg111/Arg133/Asp121/Tyr123 to C5 of positions 8 and 33 (present in both conditions)
water-mediated contacts at the mCpG step

qc.thermodynamics: from production_log.csv: temperature, potential energy, box volume, density; first- vs second-half means compared with block standard errors (block length >= 1 ns)
qc.dna: core duplex heavy-atom RMSD (B4-B18 / C24-C38, excludes the 5' overhangs and two terminal base pairs at each end); Watson-Crick N1-N3 distance <= 3.2 A per base pair, including the mCpG pairs B8-C34 and B9-C33
qc.association: number of protein-DNA residue pairs in contact per frame; flag if no primary pair is in contact for > 10 ns
qc.occupancy_stability: cumulative occupancy at 25, 50, 75 and 100% of the post-burn-in trajectory, and in 5 equal blocks
qc.replicate_agreement: per primary pair: range and SD across replicates; whole-map mean absolute difference and Spearman correlation between replicates
qc.interpretation: flags trigger inspection and are reported; they are pragmatic thresholds, not proof of convergence. RMSD flattening alone is never taken as convergence.
